name: Layla Haddad
bioBlurb: Large-scale muralist known for weaving geometric desert motifs into contemporary color fields. Works fast on-site with a crew of two.

name: Tomas Vindel
bioBlurb: Portrait-driven muralist working in a soft, editorial illustration style. Frequently commissioned for brand activation walls.

name: Amina Koroma
bioBlurb: Textile-pattern muralist translating woven motifs onto architectural surfaces at scale, often collaborating with local artisans.

name: Farid Al-Otaibi
bioBlurb: Live event painter capturing the room in real time on a 2x3m canvas — a recognizable, shareable centerpiece for any stage.

name: Nadia Obradović
bioBlurb: Abstract live painter working to a live DJ set — a performance piece as much as a finished canvas.

name: Khalid Mansouri
bioBlurb: Rapid-fire caricature and scene painter, popular for guest-facing activations where the art doubles as a keepsake.

name: Sara Abdel Rahman
bioBlurb: Modern Arabic calligrapher blending classical script forms with minimalist composition — live commissions or gallery pieces.

name: Hugo Berthelsen
bioBlurb: Western letterform artist specializing in live name-writing and personalized guest favors at scale.

name: Reem Baqader
bioBlurb: Gold-leaf and ink calligrapher producing large ceremonial pieces for openings, launches, and VIP gifting.

name: Elin Sandqvist
bioBlurb: Kinetic light sculptor building responsive installations that react to sound and movement across a venue.

name: Youssef Nasrallah
bioBlurb: Drone-light choreographer designing synchronized night-sky formations as an opening or closing moment.

name: Petra Lindqvist
bioBlurb: Neon and glass light artist crafting bespoke illuminated signage and sculptural pieces for permanent or temporary display.

name: Malak Fahmy
bioBlurb: Sand and sculptural-media artist producing large temporary installations inspired by regional landscape forms.

name: Dario Conti
bioBlurb: Metalwork sculptor building modular geometric forms that can be reconfigured across different venue footprints.

name: Hana Almutairi
bioBlurb: Ceramic and mixed-media sculptor creating intimate, tactile installations designed for closer, slower engagement.

name: Omar Siddiqui
bioBlurb: Contemporary dance-theatre performer building short, site-responsive pieces for openings and transitions between programming.

name: Inês Pereira
bioBlurb: Stilt and aerial performer leading a roaming troupe through crowds — high visual impact for arrival and transition moments.

name: Abdullah Al-Shehri
bioBlurb: Percussion-led performance ensemble blending traditional rhythms with contemporary staging for large open-air crowds.

name: Zoya Nabiyeva
bioBlurb: Projection-mapping artist turning building facades into moving canvases — a signature opening-night moment.

name: Marco Esposito
bioBlurb: Generative-visuals artist producing real-time reactive backdrops for stages, synced live to sound and lighting cues.

name: Lina Farouk
bioBlurb: AR/interactive-media artist building phone-activated overlays that extend a physical installation into a digital layer.

name: Victor Holm
bioBlurb: Immersive-environment builder creating walk-through installations that anchor an entire zone of a venue.

name: Dana Al-Qassemi
bioBlurb: Sound-and-textile installation artist working with suspended forms that shift gently with ambient airflow.

name: Felix Brandt
bioBlurb: Botanical installation artist transforming venues with living, modular greenery structures built for photo moments.
